why: Row 97 covers a change to 'another proposal term' in the confirming turn and says 'propose the changed proposal', while row 96 and CO-03 say to propose only the total paid to the order's payment method, so for 'Yes, but put the refund on my Mastercard' two parts of the spec disagree about the same case. G-02 ('exact proposal') does block acting on the Visa yes, but it leaves that conflict standing, and no scenario covers the case (CO-S03 row 4 changes only the order; CO-S09 raises it in Turn 1).
